CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

2. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

3. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 24

7. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 7

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

10. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 25

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 14

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

14. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

15. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 29

16. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
